text:
Predicates:
BornIn(x, y) ::: x was born in city y.
American(x) ::: x is American.
Book(x) ::: x is a book.
Novel(x) ::: x is a novel.
WrittenBy(x, y) ::: x is written by y.
Created(x, y) ::: x is created by y.
Podcast(x) ::: x is a podcast.
City(y) ::: y is a city.
Year(y) ::: y is a year.
WroteIn(x, y) ::: x was written in year y.
Premises:
BornIn(daniShapiro, americanCity) ∧ American(daniShapiro) ::: If Dani Shapiro was born in American City, then she is American.
Book(familyHistory) ∧ WrittenBy(familyHistory, daniShapiro) ∧ Novel(familyHistory) ∧ WroteIn(familyHistory, 2003) ::: Family History is a novel written by Dani Shapiro in 2003.
Created(daniShapiro, familySecrets) ::: Dani Shapiro created Family Secrets.
City(boston) ∧ American(boston) ::: Boston is an American city.
Conclusion:
BornIn(daniShapiro, boston) ::: Dani Shapiro was born in Boston.
